_note: v2: this file holds ONLY Tier 5 (Werner's manual picks) + system settings. Algorithmic tier holdings 1-4 are in data/tier_holdings.json (regenerated monthly by select_tiers.py).

werner_picks.name: Werner's Picks
werner_picks.description: Discretionary portfolio. Structural judgment, not algorithm.
werner_picks.holdings_source: data/holdings.json — the only holdings source from 2026-09-09 (dashboard order P3.1); ticker, shares, cost basis, acquisition date, cash

cost_model._note: Order 9-Sept C1: quoted spread + fixed impact per trade, one-way, applied to one-way turnover in NAV-weight space at every rebalance (names AND the regime overlay's cash-sleeve resizing). transaction_cost_bps above is the derived one-way total and must equal half_spread_bps + impact_bps.

1_cap_pres.name: Capital Preservation
1_cap_pres.description: Defensive sectors only, high-margin profitable names. Heavy hedging.

2_balanced.name: Balanced Growth
2_balanced.description: Full universe, equal-weight 3 technical factors + fundamentals. Moderate hedging.

3_aggressive.name: Aggressive Growth
3_aggressive.description: Full universe, double weight on 6-month relative strength. Light hedging.

4_tactical.name: Tactical Alpha
4_tactical.description: Concentrated 8-name basket, momentum tilt, no cash floor. Regime is the brake.

strat_tier._note: Order 8-Oct-2026 J6: the STRATIFIED paper tier (scripts/strat_tier.py, scripts/analyst/strat_holdings.py). The registered candidate-list score failed its test on 8 October 2026 (data/analyst/candidate_list_test_result.json); the owner keeps a live record of it apart from the four tiers. Not a tier_specs entry: nothing that iterates tier_specs sees it; it is outside the ranking.
strat_tier.name: Stratified
strat_tier.label: paper tier · DIAGNOSTIC · its registered test failed on 8 October 2026
strat_tier.rebalance_rule: on the last session of March, June, September and December, to the holdings file of that month-end (the latest file at or before the session); a file that appears later is applied on the first session it exists, recorded as late
strat_tier.weights: equal weights, fully invested, no regime cash
strat_tier.cost: the C1 model (system_settings.cost_model): 10 bps one-way on NAV-weight turnover, on every trade
strat_tier.score: 43 variables; the mean of the within-month percentile ranks of the ridge with penalty 100 and the harness's boosted tree; refitted each January on month-ends whose 12-month outcome ended before that year (scripts/analyst/candidate_list_test.py on walkforward_test.py)
strat_tier.registration: data/analyst/candidate_list_test_registration.json (its sha256 is recorded in every holdings file)
strat_tier.verdict: no verdict rule; each quarter-end scripts/strat_quarter_report.py gives the return since inception against QQQ, SPY and RSP

continuous_rules._note: Audit order 30-Sept-2026 4.1: the twins' execution rule. compute_twins.py reads rules_file; any parameter present here must equal the file's or the run is refused.
